story: The Northen Boobook (Ninox japonica) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Strigidae family. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Northen Boobook is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists.
